subject.title: fix(mcp): honor `disabled` flag to prevent spawning disabled servers

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `mcp.servers.*.disabled` as a second public config key, or only repair it into canonical `enabled` during doctor/write migration?
rationale: The patch changes the exported schema and runtime config contract; repository policy and current documentation favor one canonical shape, but accepting foreign hand-edited config is a product compatibility choice.

options.title: Migration-only alias
options.body: Accept `disabled` only as raw repair input, rewrite it to `enabled`, remove it from persisted config, and keep runtime/type/schema surfaces canonical.

options.title: Public supported alias
options.body: Keep both keys, but explicitly document precedence, define conflicting-value behavior, align Control UI edits, and add fresh-install and upgrade coverage.

options.title: Decline the alias
options.body: Close the linked report with guidance to use the already-supported `enabled: false` field and avoid adding any compatibility path.

recommendation.title: Migration-only alias
recommendation.body: Accept `disabled` only as raw repair input, rewrite it to `enabled`, remove it from persisted config, and keep runtime/type/schema surfaces canonical.
